sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 12 February 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000054-P1 was put before Desert Bloom Family Clinic 054 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 3.25 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Tdap preferred-position minimum of 65 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer has not yet responded.
